body:
We should produce lots of mobile first mini game.

Which we later will be able to redistribute as web apps, mobile apps, telegram bot apps, vk-mini apps and so on.

We sure will need some game-core library and game template repositories.

We should be able to start with React.js + JavaScript + Capacitor + Electron and so on.

We should use github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai (there we have associative tech stack description, we also need to introduce CI/CD workflows in each repository where once issue arrives we try to execute latest formal-ai to produce results on pull request, pull request must be created automatically using what we do in github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind).

CI/CD workflow should also be restartable automatically so we can execute it on the same pull request as many times as we need.

Here we need to make a detailed plan for core infrastructure, that should be prepared so we can produce production ready games easy.

We also need to research for the most popular and successful games ideas, which can be legally reimplement in our own style.

We should also check github.com/linksplatform and produce some lore core, where we try to use links as characters and so on, they should cute, funny and likable by toddlers, children and adults.

If something is not adorable it is a bug.

All games and apps should be somehow connected into single ecosystem/universe, where we have common lore, which in itself contains lots of wisdom and useful lessons.

We should position our games as cool high quality games with educational elements, so each person that plays our games not only gets dopamine, but also learns something new.

We should start by producing the simplest possible to implement games, fully open-source and public domain, yet we don't advertise what games are open-source much, so we may have a chance to get profit or donations and so on.

All games must be free to play with some custom subscriptions, and we start them ads free, yet we should allow to use adds as ability to get some advantage in games as well as subscriptions. But by default we should be more generous than all other competitor games, and don't ask for subscription or ads longer.

We should have all mechanics in place so we can experiment with them.

We also need to plan to build big global community, so we encourage taking part in development of games out of good will or if we have enough budget we will get some developers/designers hired.

And also big community can be source of additional revenue streams as donations, merchandize and so on.

We should be profitable and be able to attract more and more capital to reinvest in quality and quantity growth.

As well as meta links theory related characters we can develop our own anime characters in multiple styles, like chibi and normal 3D and so on.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Initial master plan
